description: Create a Code Engine build configuration that builds a container image server-side (no local Docker/Podman needed). Supports a Git source (source_type=git with source_url) or local. The output_secret must be a registry secret with PUSH access to the target namespace.

output_secret.description: Registry secret with push access (e.g. icr-push-secret)

source_context_dir.description: Subdirectory within the source that contains the Dockerfile (optional)

strategy_spec_file.description: Dockerfile path relative to context (default: Dockerfile)

name: ce_create_build
